notes.title: Trials of 20
notes.content:
Level 13 started as an experiment to see how far I could go; how big the levels could get. It turns out you can have 100 turrets lined up shooting 0.1 times per second and run at 100 frames on a bad system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36251489/b8e79658e5f9167630f4485d4298be5f2ac383c7.png[/img]
And also there might be anti-gravity..
